LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingDisplayMode: How much of the maths to show
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_DisplayModePlainDesc: Signal bars and a plain-English reason. Radio just works.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_DisplayModeOperatorDesc: Adds the band, the signal-to-noise ratio, the margin and which direction limits the link.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_DisplayModeEngineerDesc: The whole link-budget sheet, every gain and loss, in both directions.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingMetresPerCellDesc: What one map cell measures. Decide before you start a colony: changing it later changes every distance and cable loss, so links that worked may stop. The game never defines it; 1 m matches the furniture, about 26 m matches walking speed.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingInTouchThought: "In touch with home" mood for colonists whose radio reaches a base station
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingTerminalNoiseDesc: A radio terminal's computer makes electrical noise, as real computers do, so an antenna close to it, its own stub antenna included, hears colonists less well. Turn it off to treat the terminal as quiet.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingDeskWaterfall: Show the waterfall on the radio desk
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingDeskWaterfallDesc: Gives the radio desk the same Waterfall tab as the radio terminal: each colonist's radio as a streak over the noise it hears. Off by default, as the waterfall is the software radio's own picture.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingInTouchThoughtDesc: A small mood bonus for a free colonist wearing a hand-held with a working link to a base station. Turn it off to keep the radios as a pure readout.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_NetBusy: Every channel that can hear this radio is taken by others; it waits for one to come free.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_StationChannels: Channels: {INUSE} of {CHANNELS} in use, {WIDTH} kHz each; {FREE} free.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_StationChannelKind: {KIND}: {HELD} in use by {SERVED} radios; room for {ROOM} more.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_WaitingOperator: Waiting for an operator: a colonist must work the station that serves it, and have a hand free for it.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_StationOperator: Vehicles on its channels: {COUNT}. {OPERATOR} is working it, and drives up to {MAX} at once.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_StationNoOperator: Vehicles on its channels: {COUNT}. Nobody is working it, so it drives none: a colonist assigned to remote operation will come.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_StandingBy: Standing by: this radio takes a channel only while it is driven from a station.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_StationNoPower: The base station has no power, so there is nothing to reach.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_NoStation: No base station on this map, so there is nothing to reach.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_StationNoRadios: No hand-held radios worn on this map, and no vehicle with a radio.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SitingQuiet: Quiet: no colony noise reaches here
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_CoverageShown: Map shows how well a hand-held would reach this station from each spot: brighter is better, dark red is no contact. Doors count as closed.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_CoverageWorking: Working out radio coverage on the map: {PERCENT} done.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_CoverageUpdating: Something here changed: updating the radio coverage on the map, {PERCENT} done. The picture shown is the last one until then.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_CoverageNoStation: No coverage to show: connect this antenna to a base station with coax.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_WaterfallTitle: {BAND}: newest at the top, brighter for a stronger signal
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_WaterfallNote: Each streak is a colonist's radio as it arrives here, on the channel the station gave it. Each channel is {WIDTH} kHz; up to {RADIOS} voice radios share one, taking turns.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_WaterfallNobody: No colonist wearing a hand-held is in reach: only the noise this station hears.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_AmplifierNoStation: Raises a station's signal up to {RATED} W. Join it into the coax between a station and an antenna.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_AmplifierUnpowered: No power: signals pass through it unamplified.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_AmplifierOutput: Raises {STATION}'s signal to {OUTPUT} W (rated {RATED} W), on the antennas whose cable runs through it.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_PortCableNoAntenna: Coax connected, but no antenna on it.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_PortCableNoStation: Coax connected, but no base station on it.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_OperatorSummary: {BAND}: signal {SNR} dB above the noise, margin {MARGIN} dB. Limited by: {DIRECTION}. Distance {DISTANCE} m.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_TurretWatched: Watched from {STATION}: it fires at enemies, and can be aimed by hand.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_TurretNoStation: No working radio station on its coax or, while enemies are about, in its radio's reach: it holds fire. Connect it to a station with coax, or bring a station within reach.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_TurretNoOperator: Linked to {STATION}, with nobody at the console: it holds fire. While enemies are about, a colonist on remote operation takes the console.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_TurretNoHand: Linked to {STATION}, but the operator's hands are full with vehicles and other turrets, or its picture finds no channel: it holds fire.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_VehicleWhyNoOperator: Nobody is working the console at {STATION} any more.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_VehicleWhyHandsFull: {OPERATOR} at {STATION} has their hands full with other vehicles.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_VehicleWhyChannelsFull: Every channel of the stations that can hear it is in use.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_VehicleWhyOutOfReach: No working radio station can hear it: it is out of reach, too much stands in the way, or the station has lost its power.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_TurretFiresAlone: Fires at enemies by itself, with nobody watching.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioReach_InTouch: In radio reach of {HOME}: {KM} km away, inside the {HORIZON} km horizon, {MARGIN} dB to spare.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioReach_OverHorizon: Out of radio reach of {HOME}: {KM} km away, past the {HORIZON} km horizon. A higher aerial at either end reaches further.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioReach_TooWeak: Out of radio reach of {HOME}: {KM} km away, and the signal is too weak ({MARGIN} dB short).
LanguageData.PhobosRadioReach_Blocked: Out of radio reach of {HOME}: {KM} km away, with high ground on the way ({GROUND}) blocking the signal ({MARGIN} dB short). A higher aerial at either end, a relay on that high ground, or a spot with a clear way home would reach.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioReach_InTouchRelayed: In radio reach of {HOME} through {RELAYS}: {KM} km to home, the weakest hop {MARGIN} dB to spare.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayTakeDownDesc: Take this relay mast down for good. Calls no longer pass through it.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayInspect: A relay mast, {METRES} m: passes radio calls on toward home.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayBuildGizmoDesc: Put up a small solar relay mast here, {METRES} m tall, from {STEEL} steel and {COMPONENTS} components in the convoy's cargo. It passes radio calls on toward home for any convoy of yours in reach of it, until it is taken down. The convoy must stop.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayBuilt: {CONVOY} put up a relay mast here.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayRefuseMoving: The convoy must stop to put up a mast.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayRefuseHere: A relay mast already stands here.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayRefuseShort: It needs {STEEL} steel and {COMPONENTS} components; the convoy carries {HAVESTEEL} and {HAVECOMPONENTS}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_CoverGizmoDesc: Colour the world map by how well a radio standing on each tile would reach the place selected. Brighter is stronger, dark red is too weak to use, and ground left unpainted is past the horizon. High ground on the way casts a shadow, and a hill lights up from further off.\n\nPick the radio at the far end, for this place alone or for everywhere a call could get home from, straight to a station or passed on by relays. One place's picture follows whichever of your places with a radio you select. Either stays until you switch it off.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_CoverNetworkWorking: Working out radio coverage home, through relays ({KIND}): {PERCENT} done.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_CoverNetworkShown: Radio coverage home, through relays ({KIND}): {TILES} tiles in reach, from {PLACES} stations and relays. Brighter is stronger; dark red is too weak. A relay with every channel in use still refuses a call.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_CoverNetworkNone: Radio coverage home, through relays ({KIND}): nothing to show. It needs a powered radio station at home, with a Morse key for Morse.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_CoverRefuseNoKey: {KIND}: no station here has a Morse key
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_CoverRefuseRelayMorse: {KIND}: a relay passes on speech only
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_CoverShown: Radio coverage ({KIND}): {TILES} tiles in reach. Brighter is stronger; dark red is too weak.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioReach_NoStation: Out of radio reach of home: no powered radio station at home.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioReach_RelayBusy: {RELAYS} would pass the call on, but every channel there is in use.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayUse: Passing on {CALLS} calls: {HELD} of {CHANNELS} channels in use.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayUseFull: Passing on {CALLS} calls: all {CHANNELS} channels in use. Another call has to wait, unless it is orders to a vehicle.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayPostLine: A relay mast, {METRES} m, on {CHANNELS} channels: passes radio calls on toward home.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_RelayPostUnmanned: Nobody is keeping the relay: it passes nothing on.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioAdvice_ReasonAid: Talked through by radio by {ADVISER} ({SKILL} {LEVEL}), with a {AID} at hand
LanguageData.PhobosRadioAdvice_CallOpened: {ADVISER} is talking {CARER} through {ACT} by radio: {CARER} works as {SKILL} {LEVEL} instead of {OWN}, a little slower.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioAdvice_CallDropped: {ADVISER}'s radio call with {CARER} dropped. {CARER} carries on alone, at {SKILL} {OWN}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioAdvice_Helped: {ADVISER} talked {CARER} through {ACT} by radio: {CARER} worked as {SKILL} {LEVEL} instead of {OWN}.
